notes.title: Publishing Announcement
notes.notes:
Heyho everyone,

It has been exciting past weeks since we last reached out to you - and we are even more excited to share everything that happened so far - Let’s not waste any second - hold tight, here we go:


[u][b]We have found a new partner in Daedalic Entertainment, supporting us in publishing our game![/b][/u]


[previewyoutube=Ca9bjZqqll0;full][/previewyoutube]

As you can imagine, this news alone brings a plethora of new possibilities for us, affecting the future ahead of Coins, Crown & Cabal on a huge scale. Thanks to our new partner, we can now develop the game to the extent we have always hoped and dreamed of. An example of this is the heists, which you will be able to play in turn-based combat in the finished game. This is just one point, besides this, we will introduce even more features in the upcoming months, so stay tuned!

But this is not everything - we listened closely to you, our most dedicated community, and together with our Publisher Daedalic Entertainment we decided [u]to change our path from “Free to Play” to an “oldschool” Buy-to-Play Model. [/u]
We are aware that some of you followed us specifically for Coins, Crown & Cabal being planned as a Free-to-Play Title, but after careful reconsideration we believe that the majority of the community, the game itself - as well as its development - benefit far more from this change. 

Eventhough we can not speak about concrete price tags yet, one thing is clear - we are still the same Indie Devs, working on the same Indie title - so you can expect Indie prices.

This means as well, that [u]we focus our development power mainly on the PC version[/u] of Coins, Crown & Cabal, [u]which inevitably leads to us stepping away from developing the game for mobile platforms[/u].

We know this is a really impacting decision. Nevertheless, developing C³ together with you, our community, is still very important to us! To do so, we will launch several alpha test phases later this year (more details to come in the following weeks).

We made those decisions to ensure that the majority of our playerbase can experience the game in its full scale that we envisioned for you, from the beginning.
As you can imagine, there are still many things that need to be tied down and discussed internally, which is why you can [u]expect further information coming soon[/u].

Best Regards and a big thanks to all of you,
Magni Games & Daedalic Entertainment
